title: Investigation underway into death of Regina man
article: A Regina man has died after being pepper sprayed by police earlier this week.
Tuesday's incident began when 32-year-old Vernon Dale Crowe began having a seizure at the Souls Harbour Mission.
Ambulances were called and while Crowe was being treated, he became combative. That's when police were called.
As soon as the first officer arrived, he was assaulted by Crowe, receiving minor injuries.

Police used pepper spray to restrain the patient so he could be transferred to hospital. Crowe's condition deteriorated and he died. An autopsy is being done to determine the exact cause of his death.
